# Documentation Synchronization

## Inputs
- Behavior/architecture changes
- Updated requirement IDs and ADR links

## Procedure
1. Update requirements and traceability artifacts.
2. Update architecture and ADR references.
3. Update roadmap/open questions where scope changed.
4. Validate diagram syntax and document links.

## Output Contract
- Updated documentation file list
- Traceability updates summary
- Validation result
